notes: The township also runs a Vernal Pool Patrol citizen science program and short educational programs 1 to 2 times a month. It reported 415 members in 2025. Good for service hours; ask whether a signed hours form is available.
name: Meridian Conservation Corps (volunteer workdays)
what_you_do: Join workdays in township parks and preserves, every other Saturday or every other Thursday, to help care for township land. Equipment is provided.
who_can_apply: The page says all ages and experience levels are welcome.
duration: Stewardship Saturdays are every other Saturday, 9:30 a.m. to noon. Weekday Warriors are every other Thursday, 1 to 3 p.m.
deadline_text: Ongoing. Join the email list with the sign-up form.
how_to_apply: Fill out the MCC sign-up form to get on the email list. Questions: Land Stewardship Coordinator at 517-853-4614 or ecampbell@meridian.mi.us.
